name: Absolutely
bio: Absolutely, born Abby-Lynn Keen, is a British singer-songwriter from South London. Known for blending alternative pop, R&B and electronic music, she released two albums: "Cerebrum" (2023) and "Paracosm" (2026).
place: Tooting, South London, England, United Kingdom

credits.overview: Marking the opening of the 60th edition of the Montreux Jazz Festival, RAYE invites a host of international pop stars to join her on stage for an evening of music.
